maya: Heads-up — bringing up q4b-int4-v2 on staging for a quick smoke. Saw a consistent quality delta on long-context conversational prompts from promptset-entropy-4 (longturns). Need a fast dedupe + golden sanity before we push more quant builds.

anil: Which quant build exactly and can you paste the bench diffs/examples?

maya: Build = q4b-int4-v2 (per-kernel rescale + pruning). Quick numbers from the smoke run: latency ~1.1x, throughput -5%, but quality deltas look worse: rouge-l -4.6 pts, rerank acc -4.2 pts. Examples show truncation-ish hallucinations on turn >1024.

maya: ```
# smoke-summary
model: q6b-baseline    rouge-l: 0.734, rerank-acc: 0.921
model: q4b-int4-v2    rouge-l: 0.688, rerank-acc: 0.879
delta rouge-l: -0.046
notable: failures on multi-turn prompts with long instructions / repeated context
```

sophie: Could be dataset/label mismatch or near-duplicates in the seedbank — when we compress/quantize the decoder logits the model sometimes picks shorter canned completions if the prompt overlaps with older, higher-frequency samples. I'll run a fuzzy-dedupe scan on the seedbank subset for promptset-entropy-4.

sophie: Command I'll run: `curate-cli scan --bank seedbank/legacy --subset promptset-entropy-4 --fuzzy 0.78 --out tmp/dedupe_1799990011.csv` :mag_right:

jorge: I can push a golden relabel job for the flagged samples. Proposal: 200 items prioritized by ctxlen>1024 and multi-turn. Label team ETA ~3h. If we see annotator drift we can expand to 500.

maya: Good. Also noticed earlier kv-cache short-prefix collisions that might surface on these long prompts — could be decoding bias interacting with quant scales. @anil can you sanity-check token-index mappings / kv handling? :eyes:

anil: Will do. I suspect quant-rescale on attention keys may change the relative magnitude for farther tokens. I'll run token-walk and kv-fwd on the failing examples. Also grab the exact model weights + quant table from the staging bundle.

deploy-bot: deploy started: staging/q4b-int4-v2 by maya @ 2026-03-23T15:21Z :rocket:

sophie: Started dedupe sweep, writing flags to `tmp/dedupe_1799990011.csv`. I'll push the top-200 candidate list to /curation/reviews for Jorge's golden job. :thumbsup:

jorge: Golden job created: `golden/1799990011-q4b-smoke-200` assigned to label-team; due EOD today. Link: https://labflow/golden/1799990011 (internal)

maya: If golden confirms regression we rollback the q4b-int4-v2 build and run a hybrid q6b-int4 calibration. If golden says it's label/dedupe noise, we'll augment promptset and rerun smoke.

anil: TL;DR action plan: (1) dedupe sweep (sophie) (2) golden relabel (jorge) (3) tokenization + kv cache check (anil) (4) rebench + compare on the same eval harness. Ping me if you want me to run detailed logits diffs.

sophie: I'll also add a short heuristic to the curation pipeline: if near-dup ratio for a new promptset > 0.12, create a blocking ticket and auto-queue golden sampling. That should catch these early.

maya: Thanks all — waiting on the golden results before broader rollout. Will update here once we have relabel verdict + logs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
